name: EthOS AntiVirus
description: ClamAV antivirus with a native EthOS window: full, custom and scheduled scans, quarantine copies, scan logs and configurable scan options. Read-only scans of /home, /mnt and /media; signatures update automatically.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 2.1.0: Synology-style options — quarantine copies, whitelist/file-type/size filters, smart scan, scan log, scheduled scans, definition info and a persistent package data volume. 2.0.1: Package Center icon. 2.0.0: native EthOS window UI; package service bound to loopback and reached through an authenticated proxy. 1.0.1: clearer first-start status and longer scan timeout.
